svg.title: From evaluation to recommendation
svg.desc: 1. Engineering rates specification compliance and fills the TBE matrix; QS rates the price. 2. A database constraint requires both gates before a quotation can be FINAL. 3. The total of each quotation is the sum of unit price times BOQ volume. 4. If every FINAL candidate has a TBE score, score = 0.6 x (lowest total / total) x 100 + 0.4 x TBE; otherwise the cheapest is shown with the reason. 5. The same function feeds the screen, the exported working paper and the assistant's comparison tool; QS marks the selected vendor separately.
